name: Lee County 2024–25 FAST/BEST/FAA School Grades district comparison
model_scope: Lee County independent 2024–25 grade-school district models use exact NCES LEA 1201080 / FL-36 / FDOE 36 identities. All 78 audited pure lower profiles with positive or protected Fall grades 3–8 and explicit-zero grades 9–12 remain searchable. Original whole-percent School Grades Math and ELA achievement supports 78 schools in each separate Math, ELA and independently fitted Combined model. Same-year individual February lunch-status counts use their own school denominator. Published accountable FAST PM3, BEST/Access EOC and eligible FAA achievement retains full-year, home-zoned, ELL and exemption rules; Datafolio and percent-tested participation remain separate. High, mixed, primary, closed and unmatched scopes remain outside this point-only release. Valid-score denominators and the ten-valid-scored floor remain uncertified; sampling intervals are unavailable modelwide.
map_source: School coordinates and district boundaries are unavailable in the audited Lee County source release.

income_definition.label: Individual free/reduced-price eligibility and direct certification
income_definition.definition: 2024–25 Final Survey 3 February PK–12 school individual eligibility: original free lunch D/F plus reduced-price 3/E plus direct-certification C/R counts divided by that school’s own reported denominator. Provision 2 code 4 must be explicitly zero. District option 6/9 conversions to C/D are already required by the original data element. Federal funding multiplier columns, School Grades economic percentages, universal meal availability, enrollment substitutions and another-year income are not used. CEP individual identification coverage remains unknown; this is an economic disadvantage proxy.
